summary: Baileys fork: keyword co-occurrence in generic utils, no traced installer harm
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A static keyword co-occurrence pattern fired in lib/Utils/generics.js (tokens 'ping', 'GET', 'id') within a general-purpose utilities file typical of Baileys' HTTP/keepalive helpers. No install-time lifecycle exfiltration, no read of installer-secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no hardcoded attacker C2, no dropper, no backdoor was observed. The matched primitives are consistent with normal socket/keepalive and HTTP utility code in a WhatsApp client library rather than an exfiltration pathway; the fork status and namespace resemblance to upstream @whiskeysockets/baileys are noted as context but no malicious code path is traced in this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
